verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that the Mintlify CLI lets developers preview locally and "catch build errors before deploying to production" [mintlify-docs-11], plus per-PR preview deployments for review before merge [mintlify-docs-17]. Nothing in the pack describes CI checks, broken-link detection, or docs.json validation, so this is a thin, indirect fit to the story. Missing for 10: documented CI/PR checks that block publishing, broken-link detection, docs.json/config schema validation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
